label: dev (image-level K-fold CV on PACO val, not a held-out test)

methods.listwise: L2 conditional logit over the query's top-k, target = highest-IoU candidate
methods.oracle_topk: highest-IoU candidate of the top-k (reranking ceiling)
methods.pointwise: L2 logistic regression, target IoU >= 0.5, features + features x part + part
methods.rule: logit + w log(max(sam_iou, 1e-3)), w from rule_grid by CV (max mean IoU on train folds)

no_target.note: reranking does not change accept decisions; from the stage's saved table

split: PACO-LVIS val I1 object/part queries (+ gRefCOCO val no-target, accept unchanged)
